description: This source file defines the ExecShellWrapperParser enum and related structures and methods for parsing shell command wrappers. It provides functionality to identify and extract commands wrapped by common shell interpreters such as POSIX shells, Windows cmd, and PowerShell.

methods.name: extract
methods.description: Main entry point for extracting a parsed shell wrapper from a command array and raw command string.

methods.name: extract:command:preferredRaw:depth:
methods.description: Recursively examines command arrays to determine if they are wrapped shell commands, respecting maximum wrapper depth.

methods.name: extractPayload:command:spec:
methods.description: Extracts the inline command payload based on the wrapper specification.

methods.name: extractPosixInlineCommand
methods.description: Extracts inline POSIX shell command if the command matches known POSIX shell wrapper flags.

methods.name: extractCmdInlineCommand
methods.description: Extracts inline Windows CMD command if the command includes '/c' flag.

methods.name: extractPowerShellInlineCommand
methods.description: Extracts inline PowerShell command based on known PowerShell flags.
